name: WinterX
description:
WinterX is WeirdMM's fan-made jailbreak companion for Spring 0.8.1 and Spring 0.9 Preview 1. Use Ruby to install independent Java/Dex and JavaScript tweak packages, then find their preferences under Spring Settings → WINTERX TWEAKS. Fresh WinterX runtimes include no tweaks.

Mac.APK uses the local bridge and a locally built WinterX engine. On a rooted Android phone, WinterX launches your original Spring through the computer's rooted bridge. Without root, your computer builds "Spring Launcher (WinterX)", a copy of your own Spring with WinterX built in, installed beside the original (tested on an Android 10 ARM64 emulator). Tweaks that need root are marked "(Requires Root)". Choose which Spring version to jailbreak before tapping Jailbreak; on Mac.APK the bridge starts that version's prepared WinterX core. This companion shows runtime status and does not jailbreak Android or install the runtime by itself.

WinterX is not an iOS jailbreak and is not affiliated with Spring or Apple.

Source code, setup guide and updates:
https://github.com/UltraFEmotes/WinterX
whatsNew: WinterX now works without root on Android: run Start WinterX Rootless on your computer. Choose Spring 0.8.1 or Spring 0.9 Preview 1 before tapping Jailbreak.
